svg.title: PC-12 General Arrangement
svg.desc: PC12-GA-001 rev A, 1:50, A1. Reconstruction from published data, not for manufacture.

g.text: SEEN FROM ABOVE · STARBOARD WING UP
SEEN FROM AHEAD · STARBOARD ON THE LEFT
MAJOR ITEMS · BALLOON NUMBERS REFER TO THE SIDE AND PLAN VIEWS
Forward fuselage & flight deck shell · Centre fuselage (pressure cabin) · Aft fuselage & tail cone
2024-T3 skins, frames 10-16; 2024-T3 skin, 5.8 psi max differential; Semi-monocoque, frames 33-40; tail-cone
Aluminium two-spar fin; glass-fibre ventral fairing
Hartzell 5-blade composite propeller (2.67 m), incl. spinner & hub
Carbon composite blades, nickel erosion shields, full-feathering, reversible
Carbon/Nomex honeycomb, Cu mesh; Carbon/Nomex honeycomb
Chin air inlet: polished lip, mouth & duct entry
Polished lip, electrically de-iced; composite duct
Trailing link, hydraulic shock strut, electromechanical actuator
Nose gear (steerable, retracts aft) · Nose-wheel fork and wheel (steering)
Hydraulic shock strut, 17.5x6.25-6 tyre, +/-60 deg steering; Steering collar, torque links, fork, 17.5x6.25-6 wheel
Airstair passenger door (0.61 x 1.35 m clear opening)
Cargo door (1.35 x 1.32 m clear opening)
Upward-opening, 120 deg (its gas struts are not modelled: owner decision)
Plug type, removed inward (0.48 x 0.64 m projected)
Weather-radar pod, right wing tip (GWX 8000, 12-in antenna)
mm UNLESS STATED · VALUES READ FROM THE MODEL
RECONSTRUCTION FROM PUBLISHED DATA — NOT FOR MANUFACTURE
Datum STA 0 is 3,000 mm forward of the firewall (frame 10).
Aircraft shown static on gear, flaps up, doors closed, one blade vertical down.
Principal dimensions per Pilatus published data (span 16,280; length 14,400; height 4,260; wing area 25.81 m²; tail span 5,200; track 4,530) and the PC-12 NGX POH three-view (wheelbase 3,480).
Engine envelope per EASA TCDS IM.E.008 (PT6E-67XP: 1,870.9 long, Ø481.8). Gear per POH 7-4.
Contours between these anchors are reconstructed estimates (glazing, winglets cross-checked).
Plan view seen from above with the starboard wing at the top; front view seen from ahead, starboard on the viewer's left. Hidden detail not shown.
